body:
I'll start by reading the contract and understanding the corpus.

Both chapters meet the contract: `02-type-system-core.md` 7,577 bytes, `03-functional-programming.md` 7,500 bytes; each has ≥8 official Source URLs, ≥2 tables, a verbatim repo-backed fence with its citation immediately above, and no Portuguese leakage. `python3 /tmp/ts-research/verify.py` reported no problems for either owned file; its 9 remaining problems belong to files outside my ownership (missing parent chapters/SKILL/VERSION and a fence in `10-api-and-declaration-design.md`).
